question: As of 2022, who is the India's last living Sadhir dancer honoured with Padma Shri Award in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Muthukannammal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R Muthukannammal:-**

 
 
• Muthukannammal is a seventh-generation Sadhir dancer from Tamil Nadu.
 
• She is the only surviving person among the 32 Devadasis who served the deity at the Viralimalai Murugan temple.
 
• She started dancing at the age of seven and dedicated herself to the temple. 
 
• **She was India's last living Sadhir dancer as of 2022.**
 
 
 
• **Sadhir:-**
 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is a vigorous and expressive dance form that is known for its intricate footwork and graceful movements.
 
• **Muthukannammal is a master of this dance form and her performances are mesmerizing.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale:-**

 
 
• She was an Indian dancer, choreographer, and social reformer.
 
• She is considered to be the "mother of Bharatanatyam", a classical Indian dance form.
 
• She was born in 1904 in Madras (now Chennai), India, into a wealthy family. She was educated in England and France, and she studied dance in Europe.
 
 
 
• **Baisali Mohanty:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian classical dancer and choreographer.
 
• She is a leading exponent of Odissi, a classical Indian dance form that originated in Odisha, India.
 
• She began her dance training at the age of five under the guidance of her mother, Guru Smt. Mayadhar Mohapatra.
 
 
 
• **Manjamma Jogati:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian Kannada theatre actress, singer, and dancer of Jogathi Nritya, a folk dance form that originated in Karnataka, India.
